title: VimSpeak Demo
summary: Ashley Feniello demonstrates VimSpeak, a voice-controlled interface for Vim inspired by Tavis Rudd's voice programming talk. The demo includes working through a VimGolf challenge by speech.
why: HN mentions it as an example of voice-driven editing, and one commenter says it clarified how Vim commands compose.

quote.text: I found VimSpeak [1] interesting because I somehow understood how to really compose vim commands
